Unfortunately I don't and don't presently have the time (at least for the next few days) to attempt to come up with one. I was hoping someone might be able to point where and why the axis_type in my Mesh would be getting swapped to Manual at some point in jax.numpy. At every point I can inspect the Mesh myself, I only ever seem to get Auto (and I don't specify the axis_type when the Mesh is defined, so Auto should be correct?). I note that the point in the jax source that throws that error (https://github.com/jax-ml/jax/blob/c0bf76b3994be483526dfdd96d93b0d695fcbdd1/jax/_src/sharding_impls.py#L1103) gets the apparently axis=Manual mesh from via `jax._src.mesh.get_abstract_mesh()` - which also shows Auto for me when I use it.

issue.body:
### Description

As per https://github.com/jax-ml/jax/issues/26586, I am trying to get my single GPU code (which is jit over vmap) to work on multiple GPUs with shard_map. I'm following the example in that issue because _without_ using shard_map I have to use a bunch of other work arounds (like setting my axes in the mesh to Explicit, adding a bunch of extra lax.sharding constraints everywhere) only to get *worse* performance across 2 GPUs than I did with 1 for the same number of jobs! I suspect some all_ operations are creeping in and slowing everything down when sharding the arrays myself and then passing them to `jit_fun = jax.jit(jax.vmap(my_fun))`

In any case, I've tried both `jax.sharding.set_mesh` and `with jax.sharding.use_mesh`, but no matter what I seem to pass to the shard_map call for the mesh or the partition specs, I am getting the following error with respect to part of my downstream function. Existing issues and the documentation have been of no help:

```sh
File "/home/cjc/jax_proj/jax_proj.py", line 93, in <lambda>
    "rule1": lambda: jnp.sum(to_check < 0, axis=1, where=mask) > 1,
                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/home/cjc/jax_proj/env/lib/python3.12/site-packages/jax/_src/numpy/reductions.py", line 307, in sum
    return _reduce_sum(a, axis=_ensure_optional_axes(axis), dtype=dtype, out=out,
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/home/cjc/jax_proj/env/lib/python3.12/site-packages/jax/_src/numpy/reductions.py", line 230, in _reduce_sum
    return _reduction(a, "sum", lax.add, 0, preproc=_cast_to_numeric,
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/home/cjc/jax_proj/env/lib/python3.12/site-packages/jax/_src/numpy/reductions.py", line 148, in _reduction
    a = _where(where_, a, init_val)
        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/home/cjc/jax_proj/env/lib/python3.12/site-packages/jax/_src/numpy/util.py", line 312, in _where
    condition, x_arr, y_arr = _broadcast_arrays(condition, x, y)
                              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/home/cjc/jax_proj/env/lib/python3.12/site-packages/jax/_src/numpy/util.py", line 267, in _broadcast_arrays
    return [_broadcast_to(arg, result_shape, result_sharding) for arg in args]
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/home/cjc/jax_proj/env/lib/python3.12/site-packages/jax/_src/numpy/util.py", line 291, in _broadcast_to
    return lax.broadcast_in_dim(arr, shape, tuple(range(nlead, len(shape))),
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/home/cjc/jax_proj/env/lib/python3.12/site-packages/jax/_src/sharding_impls.py", line 1110, in canonicalize_sharding
    raise ValueError(
ValueError: Context mesh AbstractMesh('pos': 1, 'batch': 2, axis_types=(Manual, Manual)) should match the mesh of sharding AbstractMesh('pos': 1, 'batch': 2, axis_types=(Auto, Auto)) passed to broadcast_in_dim. This error occurs at source:  /home/cjc/jax_proj/jax_proj.py:93:31 (build_all_closures.<locals>.single_closure.<locals>.check_rules.<locals>.<lambda>)
```
where the the relevant lines of code are:
```python
def check_rules(x: Array) -> Array:
    # we are closed over consts, pos, pos_cnt, mask, rule, etc.
    to_check = consts * x[pos]
    failed = jnp.zeros(pos_cnt, dtype=bool) # shape of (k,)
    # fmt: off
    rules = {"rule1": lambda: jnp.sum(to_check < 0, axis=1, where=mask) > 1,
    "rule2": ...
    # more rules
    }
    for ruleX, rule in rules.items():
        rule_type = rule_ids[ruleX]
        rule_broken = rule()
        failed = failed | jnp.where(pos_type == rule_type, rule_broken, failed)
    return failed
```
The error seems to imply that jax.numpy is changing the context mesh at some point? No matter where I print the current Mesh status, all I ever see is Auto for the axis_types.
